definitionZh: CSSshorthand 属性全部重置元素属性, unicode- bidi, 方向和 CSS Custom 属性除外 。 它可以将属性设定为它们的初始值或继承值,或者设定为另一个级联层或样式表来源中指定的值.
sourceDefinition: The all CSSshorthand property resets all of an element's properties except unicode-bidi, direction, and CSS Custom Properties. It can set properties to their initial or inherited values, or to the values specified in another cascade layer or stylesheet origin.
